servers.name: filesystem
servers.description: Official Filesystem MCP server (Anthropic), installed as a project dependency and sandboxed to the workspace directory.

servers.name: git
servers.description: Official Git MCP server (Anthropic). Install with: pip install mcp-server-git. Started without --repository so every tool takes an explicit repo_path and git_init can create new repositories.

servers.name: logistics
servers.description: Custom MCP server for this project: parcel carrier quoting, shipment creation and tracking. See servers/logistics/SPEC.md

servers.name: logistics-remote
servers.description: The same logistics server deployed to Cloudflare Workers. Enable this one and disable 'logistics' to reach it over the network instead of over a pipe.
